said.text: This is a historic win for vulnerable New Yorkers — and a turning point in our City's approach to homelessness. … With a cumulative $300 million committed across the FY27 and FY28 City Budgets, we are expanding access to housing vouchers responsibly, delivering relief to tens of thousands of New Yorkers, and putting the City on a stronger path away from costly shelter reliance and toward permanent homes.

did.text: Voted Yes on Int 0966-2026, establishing a rental assistance voucher program administered by HPD for households facing eviction or homelessness. Passed 51–0.

whyNote: Council Member Sanchez, chair of the housing committee, sponsored the voucher bill; her statement in the Council's budget-adoption release describes the same program the vote established, and she voted yes the same day. The ellipsis omits sentences of thanks to colleagues; the full statement is at the source link.
